items.title: Token-efficient MCP CLI cuts costs
items.oneliner: CLI client shrinks MCP tool payloads from tens of thousands of tokens to a few hundred using TOON.

items.title: Apple Silicon H3 inference runs natively
items.oneliner: Native MiniMax-H3 inference for Apple Silicon with Metal kernels, media support, and local multimodal generation workflows.

items.title: Pure CSS sunlight effect is cloneable
items.oneliner: Cloneable CSS demo recreates window light, blur, and leaf motion without JavaScript for visual experiments.

items.title: Static blog hosts multiplayer dungeon
items.oneliner: WebRTC dungeon shows how to build real-time multiplayer inside a static site with no central game server.

items.title: Haskell Clash FPGA walkthrough ships code
items.oneliner: Hands-on tutorial shows how to solve Advent of Code on FPGAs with Clash and a complete code repo.

items.title: Compact 2.6B model runs on-device
items.oneliner: Open model with 128K context targets on-device agents and reports 220 tokens per second on Apple M5.

items.title: Tiny 14MB agent model is downloadable
items.oneliner: Apache-licensed 45M parameter model fits phones and wearables with 28MB peak RAM for local tool use.

items.title: Rust SIMD now targets GPUs
items.oneliner: Technical walkthrough explains how portable Rust SIMD maps onto GPUs for one vector codepath across architectures.

items.title: Claude Code workspace template is reusable
items.oneliner: Practical guide with GitHub starter workspace shows how to structure Claude Code for repeatable product work.

items.title: ChatGPT website prototype guide is actionable
items.oneliner: Step-by-step tutorial walks from idea to working website prototype using ChatGPT Work and Codex.
